reason: The README clearly describes a web UI authentication and account-management plugin with login gating, session routes, account settings, and local credential persistence; human review is appropriate because it changes application access control and handles account data.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加登录门禁、会话管理和账号设置功能。
summaries.en: Adds a login gate, session management, and account settings to the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Enforces a login gate over the web interface
Provides login, logout, session validation, and account update HTTP routes
Persists account data and password hashes in a local profile file
Adds account settings and logout controls to the application UI
